description: Scans loaded workflows (including promoted subgraph widgets) for image, video, and audio inputs whose files are not available, verifies candidates against assets, stores per-workflow results, and renders the missing-media error card.

characterizationScenarios.name: Missing media scan finds and verifies unavailable media inputs, including promoted widgets
Missing media card lists references and the error surfaces in the browser
Flagging missing media on workflow load leaves node previews intact

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
The missing-media scan and store keep reading litegraph, node definitions, assets, canvas, and workflow stores; that coupling remains visible and classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
